retrievalProfile.description: A candid-style studio group portrait featuring high-contrast black and white photography with bold primary-colored typography overlays.
excludeWhen: modern digital clean photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A horizontal group of five men in 1980s casual attire (denim, vests, t-shirts) posing with candid expressions against a neutral, slightly textured studio backdrop. The image uses a high-contrast monochrome or desaturated palette for the subjects, contrasted by vibrant red display text and blue script at the top center.
coreVisualRelationships: Bold red serif title centered at the top edge
Fluid blue script subtitle nested directly beneath the main title
Subjects arranged in a staggered, overlapping horizontal line
High-key lighting creating soft shadows on a neutral background
coreInvariants: High-contrast desaturated or B&W subject photography
Presence of 1980s hairstyles and denim-heavy fashion
Two-tier typographic hierarchy with contrasting colors

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up, creating a dense horizontal band.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant red title at the top center acts as the primary anchor against the desaturated image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red title, move down to the blue script, then scan the faces of the band members from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the frame is primarily negative space, reserved for the typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated greys and off-whites in the photography
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vivid primary red for the main title
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright cerulean blue for the script subtitle
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text elements against low saturation in the photographic background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to primary red and blue for graphics

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic high-contrast serif and casual cursive script
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses thick vertical strokes with sharp, bracketed serifs
Subtitle uses a continuous, handwritten-style monoline script with a slight upward slant
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' and 'R' in the main title have prominent, traditional serif feet
The script features looped ascenders and descenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, formal serif with a loose, informal script.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Times New Roman Bold or Century Schoolbook
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the traditional, high-contrast serif structure of the main title.
Captures the casual, handwritten feel of the 80s-style subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of five men in 1980s denim fashion, laughing and posing naturally against a light grey textured wall. Leave the top 30% of the image as empty background space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in bold red serif all-caps at the top center. Directly underneath, add a subtitle in bright blue cursive script with a slight upward tilt.

verificationChecks: Is the main title bright red and all-caps?
Is the subtitle blue and in a script font?
Is the photography desaturated or monochrome?
Are the subjects wearing 80s-era clothing like denim vests?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red and blue colors
mustRedesign: Avoid modern clothing styles like hoodies or slim-fit joggers
Do not use digital-looking clean gradients
Ensure the script font does not look like a modern 'wedding' calligraphy
postGenerationChecks: Check for 80s hair volume and texture
Verify the blue script is legible against the background
Confirm the high-contrast B&W aesthetic is maintained
Check that the red title is the most dominant visual element
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Rock Portrait = (Group Candid + Denim Fashion + B&W Film) + (Bold Red Serif Title / Blue Script Subtitle)
